notes: This portable C++ TCK scenario uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, the standard MIM, the adapter-selected LogicalTimeFactory and LogicalTimeInterval, the standard logical-time interval decoder and HLAinteger32BE encoding, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, logical-time configuration, and federate configuration. The monitor selects the subject's HLAfederate MIM report period with standard HLAsetTiming; the regulating subject verifies periodic HLAlookahead before and after Modify Lookahead using Query Lookahead as the service-side reference. The test makes no assumption about an implementation-specific logical-time representation and uses no provider-specific headers, names, registries, or internal APIs.
